name: Lingdong Future Holdings Co., Ltd.
summary: Lingdong Future Holdings Co., Ltd. engages in the ecological landscape business in China. The company is involved in the provision of engineering, procurement, and construction, as well as operation; surveying, design, construction, and maintenance; accommodation, catering, and other services; and investment, construction, and operation of the PPP project. It also provides grooming, pet boarding and training, interactive pet interaction, as well as pet sales. In addition, the company engages in landscape maintenance and seedling cultivation. The company was formerly known as Daqian Ecology&Environment Group Co.,Ltd. and changed its name to Lingdong Future Holdings Co., Ltd. in October 2026. …
